getAll.description:
Returns a paginated list of all book entries including invoices,
tickets, simplified invoices, additional income, and paysheets.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of related resources to embed in the `included`
array (JSON:API sideloading). Allowed values: `items`, `contact`,
`accounting_category`, `accounting_subcategory`, `items.accounting_category`,
`items.accounting_subcategory`.
Example: `?include=items,contact`.

When both `items` and `accounting_category`/`accounting_subcategory`
are requested together, each item's own accounting category/subcategory
is also embedded in `included` whenever it differs from the book
entry's own default — no separate include value needed. The explicit
nested form (`?include=items.accounting_category`, `?include=items.accounting_subcategory`)
is also accepted for clients that prefer to request it directly.

parameters.description: Include the `detailed_amounts` breakdown object in each entry. Presence of the parameter is enough — any value (including empty) enables it.

parameters.name: filter[operation_date]
parameters.description: Filter income documents by `operation_date`. Accepts a whole year (`2024` or, equivalently, `2024-all`), a quarter (`2024-Q1`), a month (`2024-3`, without a leading zero) or `all` (any date, i.e. no restriction). For an explicit range, send `filter[operation_date][from]` and `filter[operation_date][to]` instead. Documents without an operation date are matched by their `issue_date`, and drafts that have no `issue_date` yet are always included, as are additional incomes (operation date does not apply to them). Only applied together with `filter[kind]=income`; ignored otherwise.

parameters.description: End of an explicit `operation_date` range (inclusive). Must be sent together with `filter[operation_date][from]`; follows the same rules as `filter[operation_date]`.

parameters.description: Filter by payment status. Note: `unpaid` includes both `pending` and overdue entries.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Whether this is an income or expense invoice (REQUIRED)

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Issue date (REQUIRED)

attributes.name: operation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the operation took place (delivery of goods or provision of services). It must be on or before `issue_date`. Optional: on creation it defaults to `issue_date` when not sent (drafts without `issue_date` get it once they are dated), and sending `null` resets it to `issue_date`. On update, leaving it out keeps the current value, even if `issue_date` changes. A date later than `issue_date` returns 422. Only applicable when `kind` is `income` (ignored for expenses). Unlike `issue_date`, it can still be changed once the invoice is finalized, and it is silently ignored once it has been sent to AEAT. Changing it returns 422 once the invoice has been exported to accounting, included in a submitted tax model or locked by the bookkeeper (for users other than the bookkeeper managing the account, locked documents ignore it — see the update endpoint). Credit notes take the operation date of the rectified invoice unless one is sent. For an invoice to an intracommunity contact (EU, outside Spain) it is required: omitting it or sending `null` returns 422, unless the account is managed by the API user or belongs to a bookkeeper.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Invoice number. For outbound (income) invoices this is the internal filing number/reference; for inbound (expense) invoices this is the supplier's own external reference. `complete_number` takes priority over `number` when both are sent.

attributes.name: complete_number
attributes.description: Full invoice number including prefix (e.g. "INV-2024-001"), authoritative when present. For outbound invoices, sets the invoice's internal number directly (overriding `number` if both are sent). For inbound invoices, sets the internal number while `number` is stored as the supplier's external reference.

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Legacy per-numeration-series ordinal (a positive integer, sent as a string). Only meaningful together with an explicit numeration series: the final `number` is then derived from the series prefix plus this ordinal. A non-integer value is treated the same as `number`. Distinct from `complete_number`, which replaces `number` itself rather than this series-ordinal role. Kept for backward compatibility with historical/manually-numbered entries; prefer `number` / `complete_number` otherwise. Only accepted on creation — ignored if sent on an update.

attributes.name: due_date_intervals
attributes.description: Due date intervals in days from issue date

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of tag names (e.g. "vip client,important").

attributes.name: last_sent_at
attributes.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of the last time the invoice was sent. Responses return this field as an ISO 8601 date-time string.

attributes.name: equivalence_surcharge
attributes.description: Whether equivalence surcharge applies

attributes.name: credit_note_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for credit notes

attributes.name: exempt_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for VAT exemption

attributes.name: collection_type
attributes.description: Collection type

attributes.name: canary_island_special_zone
attributes.description: Canary Island special zone indicator. Required for Canary Island owners when all items have 0% VAT.

attributes.name: account_number_and_swift_bic
attributes.description: Bank account number and SWIFT/BIC code

attributes.description: Whether this series is used for amending (counter) documents.

attributes.name: applies_to
attributes.description: Defaults to `new` when omitted. Forced to `existing` for `invoices` and `tickets` series on management-mode accounts. Any other value returns 400.

update.description: Update an existing numbering series. Note: prefix cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: amending
attributes.description: Whether this series is used for amending (counter) documents.

attributes.name: applies_to
attributes.description: Can be changed from `new` to `existing`, but not back: changing to `new` returns 403. Sending the current value is a no-op.

parameters.name: filter[kind]
parameters.description:
Filter by kind. Accepts a comma-separated list. Valid values:
`expenses`, `income`, `assets`, `capital`, `creditor_debitor`, `financial`.

parameters.name: filter[active]
parameters.description: Filter by active status (categories flagged active in the owner's preferences).

parameters.name: filter[accounting_category_id]
parameters.description: Filter by accounting category ID (comma-separated for multiple)

upload.description: Upload a file as a multipart form data request.

get.description: Returns a file attached to any kind of book entry (invoices, simplified invoices, additional incomes, tickets or paysheets). The download URLs are pre-signed and expire 10 minutes after the response is generated; request the attachment again to get fresh ones.
